description: Read one published entry in full: definition, scope, boundary, distinguishing test, related identifiers, phase roles and status fields, with its versioned GitHub address and a citation line. Does not filter by review state; the requested identifier always returns. An unknown or retired identifier is an error that names the replacement or the closest identifiers. Entries describe processes in general, not the present state of any country, market or asset.

version.description: Registry version, for example "1.4.1" (a leading "v" is accepted). Default: the latest published version (1.4.1). Available: 1.0.0, 1.1.0, 1.2.0, 1.3.0, 1.3.1, 1.4.0, 1.4.1.
